items.name: Makati Speedcubing Open IV 2025

venue.name: [SM Makati](https://smstore.com/promos-events/makati/)
venue.address: Ayala Center, Barangay San Lorenzo Village, Makati City 1223 Metro Manila

items.information:
Get ready for an electrifying display of skill at the Makati Speedcubing Open IV 2025! Watch as top cubers from the Philippines and beyond compete across various Rubik's Cube events, pushing the limits of speed and precision. 

🔗 Register [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MakatiSpeedcubingOpenIV2025/register)
📄 For more details, visit [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MakatiSpeedcubingOpenIV2025)
⏳ Registration ends on September 02, 2025

It's more than just a competition; it's a celebration of mental agility and lightning-fast reflexes. Don't miss out on the thrill!
